questions.question: Контракт обновляется через set_code(). Как защитить пользователей от malicious upgrade?

options.text: Timelock: propose upgrade → 48h waiting period (users can exit) → execute. Multi-sig admin (3-of-5) для дополнительной protection
Users не нуждаются в защите — admin всегда trust-worthy

questions.explanation: Timelock + multi-sig: 1) Admin proposes new code. 2) 48h waiting period — users see proposed changes, can withdraw funds if disagree. 3) After timelock, multi-sig (3-of-5 signers) executes upgrade. This gives transparency (users can inspect new code) and exit opportunity.
